description: This file contains utility functions for Spark worker processes, including setup of memory limits, Spark files, broadcast variables, and communication with JVM.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Adds a directory to sys.path if not already present.

methods.name: read_command
methods.description: Reads a command from a file using a serializer, handling broadcast objects if necessary.

methods.name: check_python_version
methods.description: Checks if the Python version used to serialize matches the current worker's Python version.

methods.name: setup_memory_limits
methods.description: Sets memory limits for the worker process if supported.

methods.name: setup_spark_files
methods.description: Sets up Spark files, archives, and Python files for the worker environment.

methods.name: setup_broadcasts
methods.description: Initializes broadcast variables from input stream.

methods.name: send_accumulator_updates
methods.description: Sends accumulator updates back to JVM.
